q: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

s: God is described as Father (Father of Jesus's hearers in heaven)
q: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven.

s: God is perfect
q: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

s: God provides sun and rain to evil and good (impartial)
q: For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

s: Kingdom of Heaven belongs to poor in spirit (first beatitude)
q: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

s: Kingdom of Heaven belongs to persecuted for righteousness (eighth beatitude)
q: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

s: Kingdom of Heaven requires righteousness exceeding scribes and Pharisees (condition for entry)
q: unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

s: murder and anger incurs judgment being angry with his brother without a cause
q: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment.

s: adultery and lust includes lustful gazing (counts as adultery in the heart)
q: everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

s: divorce is permitted for sexual immorality (only exception stated by Jesus)
q: whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress

s: oaths is forbidden swearing at all (taught by Jesus)
q: but I tell you, don’t swear at all

s: oaths should be replaced by plain Yes and No (anything more is of the evil one)
q: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

s: God dwells in Kingdom of Heaven
q: Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

s: evil and adulterous generation pray in synagogues (to be seen by men)
q: they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men.

s: evil and adulterous generation practice fasting fasting (with sad faces, disfigured faces to be seen)
q: For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting.

s: Mammon is incompatible with serving God (one cannot serve both)
q: You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

s: charitable giving should be done in secret (not before men to be seen)
q: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret

s: prayer should be done in secret (in inner room with door shut)
q: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret

s: prayer should avoid vain repetitions
q: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do

s: Lord's Prayer is a model prayer (given as pattern)
q: Pray like this:

s: God sees secret acts (disposition: sees in secret)
q: your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

s: Lord's Prayer addresses God
q: Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

s: Lord's Prayer requests daily bread
q: Give us today our daily bread.

s: Lord's Prayer requests deliverance from the evil one
q: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.

s: fasting should do when fasting anoint your head and wash your face
q: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

s: forgiveness is condition for Father (God)'s forgiveness (forgiving others brings being forgiven)
q: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

s: forgiveness is withheld by father if people do not forgive
q: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

s: treasure should be laid up in Kingdom of Heaven (safe from moth, rust, thieves)
q: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

s: treasure is vulnerable on earth to moth, rust and thieves (earthly treasure)
q: Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

s: treasure determines location of the heart
q: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

s: anxiety is forbidden regarding life's needs and tomorrow (food, drink, clothing)
q: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

s: God rewards secret charitable giving (openly)
q: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

s: anxiety is ineffective at adding to lifespan
q: Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

s: God's Kingdom should be sought first (with his righteousness; other things then given)
q: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

s: Kingdom of Heaven is location of God
q: Our Father in heaven

s: God knows people's needs (before they ask)
q: for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

s: God feeds birds of the sky
q: Your heavenly Father feeds them.

s: God clothes lilies of the field (grass of the field)
q: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven

s: God owns God's Kingdom
q: For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever.

s: evil and adulterous generation practice charitable giving charitable giving (sound a trumpet to get glory from men)
q: don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men.

s: evil and adulterous generation have reward already received (from men)
q: Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

s: judging others results in being judged (same measure applied back)
q: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

s: those who say 'Lord, Lord' excluded from Kingdom of Heaven (merely saying it is insufficient)
q: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

s: those who say 'Lord, Lord' is rejected by Jesus (on that day; despite prophesying and mighty works)
q: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

s: wise man builds on house on the rock
q: a wise man who built his house on the rock.

s: wise man hears and does Jesus's teaching (likened to him by Jesus)
q: Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

s: house on the rock withstands storm (founded on the rock)
q: it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

s: foolish man builds on house on the sand
q: a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

s: foolish man hears but does not do Jesus's teaching
q: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

s: house on the sand falls in storm (its fall was great)
q: it fell—and its fall was great.”

s: Jesus's teaching has quality authority (unlike the scribes)
q: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

s: Jesus's teaching astonishes multitudes
q: the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

s: narrow gate and broad way leads to life (narrow gate; few find it)
q: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.
